subject: Work in progress: Unit Genome Position (UGP) files

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Work in progress: Unit Genome Position (UGP) files
parts:
FYI and related to previous questions on the list, I am working on a
new compact and fast file format for chip type specific so called unit
genome positions. This will contain chromosome and genomic positions
for all units of a chip type, and nothing else. Methods to import
such informations from dChip or Affymetrix annotation files, which are
larger and slower to parse, will be provided. For more details, see
"Work in progress" under "For developers". Any feedback is
appreciated.

/Henrik
